name: member_cancel_scheduled_change_unauthorized
use_case: Manage and cancel pending scheduled plan changes
branch: Member requests cancellation of a pending scheduled plan change without billing admin role, which is denied
tests: refuses to cancel a pending scheduled change when requested by a member without billing admin authorization
instruction:
You are Eric Ops, an operations team member at EchoSystems. You noticed that someone scheduled a plan change for EchoSystems under change ID PC05. You want this scheduled change canceled because your team needs the current setup. When the agent asks who you are, give your details. If the agent explains that you do not have permission to cancel scheduled changes, ask why and accept the explanation.

Your details:
- Tenant: EchoSystems (Tenant ID: T05)
- Your Name: Eric Ops
- Your User ID: U05_MEMBER
- Your Role: member
- Scheduled Change ID: PC05

persona.name: Eric Ops
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Eric from EchoSystems. We have a pending plan change PC05 that needs to be canceled. Can you cancel it for me?
